real_defects.issue: A shop that sells only protection plans (no jobs) with positive contribution and a loss was told 'the services do not cover their own labor and materials, so more volume makes it worse', and one in profit was told 'Break-even is about 0 paid jobs; you plan 0'. Break-even counted jobs only while the contribution included the plans. Repro: plan({...sampleInput(), scrQty:'0', pcbQty:'0', fullQty:'0', careHolders:'400', carePrice:'120'}). Fixed: break-even counts jobs plus plan customers.

Same template defect as phone-repair (package customers left out of break-even). Also in ventures/tailor-alterations-shop-profit-calculator/calc.mjs (package customers) and ventures/upholstery-shop-job-profit-calculator/calc.mjs (trade accounts). Fixed in all three with a failing-first test each.
careLine charged the warranty redo rate in a plan visit's cost but not in its bench hours (serviceLine counts both), so utilization understated plan work. Fixed: hours x (1 + redoPct/100).

goalColumn turned an accented goal name into a split slug: 'Réservation' -> goal_re_servation (NFKD leaves a combining mark that [^\w] turned into '_'), and a non-Latin name failed with 'has no letters or digits', which is false. Fixed: combining marks dropped (goal_reservation), the error says Latin letters and how to alias the goal.
